content:
Maya S: Quick lightning preflight for the webinar launch post + landing. Need a short SEO checklist we can run before publish: 3 focus keywords, minimal JSON-LD (Event + FAQ), a short internal-link sweep, and redirect CSV. Go-live next Tue.

Ravi K: Suggest primaries: "LLM inference platform", "low-latency LLM serving", "inference cost optimization". Ill draft title & meta desc variants.

Tara L: Ill add WebPage + Event JSON-LD and 3 FAQ Q/A. Sample Event snippet for head: ```<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood webinar: Serving LLMs in Prod","startDate":"2024-08-14T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/serving-llms"}</script>```

Devon P: Redirect CSV template: source,target,code. Will run 301 sweep night after publish. Example rows: ```/old-webinar,/events/serving-llms,301
/blog/2023/llm-inference,/events/serving-llms,301```

Ravi K: Internal links: PRs to add CTAs from /docs/runtime, /product/features, /resources. Anchors: "low-latency serving", "reduce inference cost", "dedicated capacity".

Maya S: Inbound routing: include utm params + webinar_id in webhook. Rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR; else -> nurture. Add "interested_in" field.

Devon P: Confirmed payload keys: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. Returns 200 OK.

Maya S: Owners: Tara (schema/copy), Devon (redirects/webhook), Ravi (links/meta), Maya (PM). Ill post the draft link here when ready.

SEO-bot: Task created  MARKETING-8100 "webinar landing SEO preflight" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-8100).
